name: scaffold
description: Create the skeleton of a new catalog skill or tool in the catalog clone — deterministic, idempotent (existing files are never touched). kind=skill: skills/<name>/SKILL.md plus an evals pair (one positive task, one no-trigger task, Harbor layout); with `tool` also tools/<tool>/ for the code the skill calls by name. kind=tool: tools/<name>/tool.json plus the stdin-JSON ABI script (script runtime) or the mcp-servers/<server>/server.json record (mcp runtime). Used by the write skill; not for editing existing records.

kind.description: skill = SKILL.md + evals pair; tool = tool.json (+ ABI script or server.json)

name.description: directory name; unique across skills and tools

description.description: one sentence with the words users actually say

root.description: catalog clone root (where skills/ and tools/ live)

tool.description: kind=skill only: also scaffold tools/<tool>/ (script runtime) that the skill refers to by name

positive.description: kind=skill: name of the task the skill must handle

negative.description: kind=skill: name of the look-alike task the skill must NOT fire on (no-trigger- prefix added)

runtime.description: kind=tool: script in the catalog, or a tool of a team MCP server

script.description: kind=tool, runtime=script: file name under scripts/

mcp_tool.description: kind=tool, runtime=mcp: the tool name that server exposes

created.description: paths written, relative to root; empty when everything already existed

todo.description: what the author still has to fill in
